svg.title: EACC: published regional connection
svg.desc: Approximately 1000 km from coastal contact near 11 degrees south to the Somali Current confluence near 3 degrees south. Review context, not an observed transit or measured current axis. Observation dates, fixed layer, uncertainty and annual ranges unknown.

g.text: Schematic only; longitudes and geographic axis unspecified.
